summary: Tactical Board Playback Animation Engine - All features tested and working. Players physically move along drawn arrow paths during playback. Playback bar UI with play/pause/stop controls and speed selector (0.5x, 1x, 2x) all functional. 3D mode animation works correctly. Error handling properly shows alerts when no arrows exist or no players near arrows.
critical_code_review_comments: S.startPlayback() correctly validates arrows exist and have playOrder before starting animation
findNearestPlayerForPlayback() uses 150px radius to match players to arrow start points
ST.playbackMoves array correctly stores player-to-arrow assignments with fromX/Y and toX/Y coordinates
renderPlaybackFrame() uses requestAnimationFrame for smooth 60fps animation
STEP_DURATION = 1500ms/speed provides correct timing for 0.5x (3000ms), 1x (1500ms), 2x (750ms) speeds
interpolatePath() supports both linear and quadratic bezier curves with ease-in-out smoothing
Player positions are updated in real-time during animation (el.x, el.y modified directly)
Arrow trail visualization: completed (blue solid opacity 0.6), active (blue stroke-width 3), future (gray dashed)
3D mode uses toIso() projection for isometric rendering during playback
Stop action shows confirm dialog to keep/restore player positions
Error handling: alerts shown for no arrows, arrows without playOrder, and no players near arrows
seed_data_creation: Test data created via JavaScript: S.addElement('playerA', x, y), S.addElement('arrow', 0, 0, {x1, y1, x2, y2})
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tactical board playback animation fully tested. Page URL: /tactical-board.html (vanilla HTML/JS, not React). Global objects: S (System), ST (State). To test playback: 1) Add players with S.addElement('playerA', x, y), 2) Add arrows with S.addElement('arrow', 0, 0, {x1, y1, x2, y2}), 3) Set playOrder on arrows, 4) Click #btn-play or call S.startPlayback(). Playback bar IDs: pb-play, pb-pause, pb-stop, pb-fill, pb-step, pb-s05, pb-s1, pb-s2.
